concerns.text: FR-001 (Text-Driven Adapter) requires implementing the core cross-attention logic to map CLIP text embeddings to KV slots. Task T017 only describes initializing the file and enforcing CPU device, but lacks the implementation of the adapter mechanism itself. The actual logic is missing.

FR-010 (Motion Labeling) requires deriving labels from optical flow. Task T034-extended is marked as incomplete (unchecked). Without this task, the downstream tasks T014, T033, and T035 cannot function, leaving FR-010 and FR-006 unimplemented.

FR-003 (Fidelity Metrics) and Constitution Principle VI require a stratified report. Tasks T016b-redo (Stratified Subsets), T021-redo (Edge Case/Manifest), and T020-redo (Reporter) are all unchecked. The chain to generate `fidelity_report.json` is broken, leaving FR-003 untraceable to an executable task.

FR-006 (Sensitivity Analysis) requires a threshold sweep and robustness report. Tasks T035 (Sweep Logic) and T035b (Interpretation) are unchecked. The plan describes the logic, but no task exists to actually produce `sensitivity_analysis.csv` or `robustness_report.json`.

FR-002 (Data Loading) and FR-012 (Memory Management) require streaming/memory safety. Task T050 (Revision Fix Memory Safety) is unchecked. While T034-extended depends on it, T050 itself is pending, creating a gap in the memory safety implementation required for the spec.

Tasks T034-sub and T042a-034 are marked as completed (checked), but the provided `spec.md` does not contain the authorized downsampling ratio in Section 3.2 or 5. This indicates a stale completion status where the task claims to have updated the spec, but the artifact state contradicts it.
